name: move_upfront_cost
description: Works out the total sum needed before the move, from the deposit, the van hire, the overlapping rent and any other one-off costs.
formula: upfront cost = deposit + van hire + (months of overlapping rent x monthly rent of the old home) + the sum of the amounts of all other one-off costs (0 if there are none)

inputs.name: deposit
inputs.description: The deposit asked for the new home, paid before the move, as an amount of money in your currency.

inputs.name: van_hire
inputs.description: The quoted price of the van for the move, as an amount of money in your currency.

inputs.name: monthly_rent_old_home
inputs.description: What the old home costs each month, as an amount of money in your currency. It is paid during the overlap.

inputs.name: overlap_months
inputs.description: How many months rent is paid on both homes, as a whole number. May be zero.

inputs.name: other_one_off_costs
inputs.description: Any other costs of the move that are paid once, such as cleaning or packing materials. Each item has name and amount (money in your currency). May be an empty list if there are none.

output.description: The total sum needed before the move, as an amount of money in your currency.
